init_seed: init random seed for numpy, torch, cuda, and cudnn with optional reproducibility mode
get_config: get merged configuration from default, model, dataset YAML files with optional overrides
parse_command_line_args: parse command line arguments in --key=value format into a typed dictionary
clean_text: clean raw text by removing HTML tags, special characters, and extra spaces
convert_config_dict: convert string values in a config dictionary to their appropriate types like bool, int, float, or list
